correctness.rationale: The exact source matrix has rank 12 and zero Gram matrix over GF(3). Exhaustive enumeration of all 3^12 primal words gives the stated W_C. Exhaustive normalized support search through size 4 finds no dual word of weight 1--3 and exactly one projective weight-4 word, with support {1,19,20,21}. The ternary MacWilliams transform gives the stated full dual enumerator, whose coefficients sum to 3^13. The bundled verifier replays all of these checks from the embedded matrix and returns VERIFY_OK.

value.rationale: Dual distance is explicitly used by the source as a structural subdivision of the length-25 classification. For a non-distance-one extremal representative, the exact minimum dual multiplicity is therefore a natural classification invariant rather than an arbitrary slice. The finding is stronger than a bare distance recomputation: it gives the full primal and dual spectra, proves there is exactly one projective minimum dual word, identifies its support, and forces a canonical four-coordinate block stabilized by every monomial automorphism. This provides a compact reproducible fingerprint for comparing or extending the new classification.
